evidence.notes: An explicit Object record with allOrNone=false and SYSTEM_MODE returns a successful SaveResult in deployable Apex test context.

source.content: @isTest private class DataDatabaseBatchBooleanSystemModeRuntimeTest { @isTest static void updateRunsInSystemMode() { Account inserted = new Account(Name = 'Boolean Insert'); insert inserted; Object updated = new Account(Id = inserted.Id, Name = 'Boolean Access Updated'); Database.SaveResult result = Database.update(updated, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(result.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Boolean Access Updated']); } }
